articles.text: 1. In the case of SMEs, the administrative fines up to EUR 1 000 000, or up to 1 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is lower, shall apply.

records.turnover_basis: total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
